meta.name: jobs-to-be-done
meta.description: Uncover customer jobs, pains, and gains in a structured JTBD format. Use when clarifying unmet needs, repositioning a product, or improving discovery and messaging.

copy.tagline: 用结构化框架梳理用户待办任务、痛点与收益
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分析用户需求、优化产品定位或改进信息传达
copy.tagline_en: Map customer jobs, pains, and gains in a structured JTBD format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze user needs, reposition products, or improve messaging

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按 Jobs-to-be-Done 框架，系统梳理客户的功能、社交、情感任务，以及他们的痛点与期望收益，最终输出结构化的分析表格。
howto.when: 当你需要澄清未满足的需求、重新定位产品、或改进发现与信息传达时，可以调用此技能。

say.text: 分析自由设计师使用我们开票工具的JTBD，这里有6份访谈摘要。
say.note: Claude 会基于摘要提取任务、痛点与收益。

say.text: 帮我梳理企业客户在项目管理中的功能任务和情感任务。
say.note: Claude 会分别列出功能与情感层面的任务。

say.text: 列出用户在使用竞品时常见的错误和未解决的问题。
say.note: Claude 会从痛点角度分析。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the Jobs-to-be-Done framework to systematically map customers' functional, social, and emotional jobs, along with their pains and gains, producing a structured analysis.
howto.when_en: Use when clarifying unmet needs, repositioning a product, or improving discovery and messaging.

say_en.text: Run JTBD for freelance designers using our invoicing tool — here are 6 interview summaries.
say_en.note: Claude extracts jobs, pains, and gains from the summaries.

say_en.text: Help me identify functional and emotional jobs for enterprise clients in project management.
say_en.note: Claude lists jobs in both categories.

say_en.text: List common mistakes and unresolved problems users face with competitors.
